policy: Static internal plugin set built, installed, and verified on an iPad. External extensions and unavailable platform dependencies remain excluded.

excluded.feature: SVG Text tool and Text Properties docker
excluded.reason: Qt Quick/QML is not part of the current iPadOS Qt profile.
Qt PrintSupport is unavailable in the current iPadOS Qt profile.

excluded.feature: LUT and Small Color Selector dockers
excluded.reason: OpenColorIO and OpenEXR are not built for the current dependency profile.

excluded.feature: Recorder video export and Composition animation export
excluded.reason: They require QProcess/FFmpeg; snapshot recording and image composition export remain available.
